title: Give prospective franchisees the Franchising Code's documents before entering into a franchise
what: Before entering into, renewing or extending a franchise agreement, a franchisor must give the prospective franchisee the documents the Code lists, starting with a copy of the franchise agreement in the form to be executed.

sources.title: Competition and Consumer (Industry Codes—Franchising) Regulations 2024
sources.quote: Documents that franchisor must give prospective franchisee (2) The franchisor must give the prospective franchisee the following documents: (a) a copy of the franchise agreement, in the form in which it is to be executed;
